briefed_facts.value: Family operated small civilian gun shop; 16 sale/repair-stock guns before incident and 13 present now; 3 civilian semiautomatic pistols reported missing; no military weapons. Stock excludes customer guns and is not fleet inventory.
Hanmo arrived 11/27 08:10 for his own civilian pistol repair and ammunition, learned loss; investigated voluntarily through day. Theft window reported 11/26 21:10 closure to 11/27 07:35 opening.
No obvious forced entry at front; rear lock closes normally. Exact entry method unknown. Owner permitted stock reconciliation and examination; no formal search powers.

3 missing gun serials retained in shop documents; one awaiting firing-pin repair, one used with filed triangular rear sight, one new compact civilian pistol. Hanmo has consented serial copies, no ownership transfer.
Father suspects son carelessly left rear access unsecured; son denies; daughter says a rear-lock sticking fault existed last week; none proves guilt or method.

At 16:40 Liao En offered 30 copper referral fee, unpaid. Claims three pistols offered at old foundry night market at 20:30, one requiring firing-pin work; image of another has similar filed triangular sight, serial not visible. Claimed seller unknown to Hanmo. May be stolen guns, another batch, or paid-tip scam.

18:23 Hanmo found Hawke walking old parts street; moved aside from workers and briefed privately, finished 18:28. Wants two reliable witnesses/companions, no violent raid, no promise of payment or compensation.

接上尤恩时他已带血且站立困难，她没看见此前致伤过程、不认识门内人影，仍不愿回病区。
尤恩带伤先到车旁，之后才有片段内两次闪光；没有认出人脸、枪型或床上黑影。

hypotheses.assessment: 区分到达与录制时间；离线迟发、转发、时钟误差、冒用均待核，不认定死人通话或已确定伪造。
对载伤者车辆射击显示真实武装威胁；阻止逃离或伤及证人是可能动机，未定。至少两个人影不等于已知两名共犯或总人数。
尤恩此前已受伤，片段内两枪不能直接当作其致伤经过。应核送医与伤情资料，尚无完整死因结论。
还在下面反映录音当时尤恩所知。当前可能隐藏、被困、被控制或已离开，不预设已死、无辜或涉案。
有人使用或控制部分区域是值得查的方向；抢劫窝点、藏赃、围堵知情者等工作假说能解释部分线索，尚无组织/规模结论。
分别查声音来源与可见物体，旧设备、暂住者或衣物都有可能；不凭恐惧判怪物、机关或共犯。
